Some aviation comebacks are worth waiting for. 💛✈️

Gary Allen’s 1946 J-3 Cub has emerged from a full restoration at Bipe Inc., at Western Carolina Regional Airport in Andrews, North Carolina.

Photographer and aviation mechanic Will Vergonet captured Gary’s first look at the revived airplane—and his first flight after the restoration—in an October 11 General Aviation News report.

The Cub returned to the airport after that flight. Will says the team plans to finish its wheel pants, then disassemble and ship it to Gary in Washington. Bipe Inc. previously restored his Stearman, too.

A vintage airplane carries more than its pilot. It carries craftsmanship, memories and the work of people determined to give it another chapter.

Here’s to the restorers keeping classic flying alive—and the owners who bring these airplanes back. 🛩️

Source: Will Vergonet’s firsthand account, General Aviation News, October 11, 2026.
